title: Fix 260: a new record is written whole or not at all
description: Fix 260: a new record is written whole or not at all
acceptance_criteria: A new record whose write fails or is cut off, by a full disk or a file-size limit, leaves no file at its name and no temporary file, the command exits non-zero naming the record, and bug list, status, next and library index --check work as before; an empty record file is named as empty; on exFAT, bug add and journal add still write whole records.

answers.constraints: records and cli lessons apply: no hard link (exFAT, #313); no new refusal and no approved sentence changed; every record writer holds the writer lock, which the fallback rename relies on
